crossRefs.note: For Yahweh your God brings you into a good land, a land of brooks of water, of springs, and underground water flowing…
God give you of the dew of the sky, of the fatness of the earth, and plenty of grain and new wine.
The wilderness grasslands overflow. The hills are clothed with gladness.
The pastures are covered with flocks. The valleys also are clothed with grain. They shout for joy! They also sing.
He sends springs into the valleys. They run among the mountains.
Woe to the crown of pride of the drunkards of Ephraim, and to the fading flower of his glorious beauty, which is on the…
I brought you into a plentiful land to eat its fruit and its goodness; but when you entered, you defiled my land, and…
For the land which has drunk the rain that comes often on it and produces a crop suitable for them for whose sake it is…

translations.web: but the land that you go over to possess is a land of hills and valleys which drinks water from the rain of the sky,
translations.bsb: But the land that you are crossing the Jordan to possess is a land of mountains and valleys that drinks in the rain from heaven.
translations.kjv: But the land, whither ye go to possess it, is a land of hills and valleys, and drinketh water of the rain of heaven:
translations.asv: but the land, whither ye go over to possess it, is a land of hills and valleys, and drinketh water of the rain of heaven,
